description: This file defines a configuration management system for PyTorch, including classes and functions for handling configs, environment variables, module installation, and patching mechanisms.

classes.name: _Config
classes.description: Represents a configurable parameter with rich behavior, including environment variable support, aliasing, and default values.

classes.name: ConfigModule
classes.description: A module type that manages configuration entries, supports attribute access, patching, and serialization.

classes.name: ContextDecorator
classes.description: A context manager supporting patching configurations, with special support for unittest.TestCase.

classes.name: SubConfigProxy
classes.description: Proxy class to handle nested configuration attributes with prefixing.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Factory function to create a _Config instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: install_config_module
methods.description: Converts a module's attributes into a ConfigModule instance with managed configs.

methods.name: get_tristate_env
methods.description: Reads an environment variable and interprets '1'/'0' as boolean True/False.

methods.name: patch_object
methods.description: Workaround for patching objects, especially ConfigModule instances.
